thread:
Aisha (CS): quick heads-up — we have ~12 onboard batches that completed with partial writes while running EU/APAC import jobs overnight. seeing truncated indexes + some duplicate records. low-severity for functionality but high-touch for enterprise onboarding renewals. drafting customer-facing note and need SRE RCA + credit proposal.
Miguel (SRE): looking into root cause now. initial signal points to a retry logic race between the importer and our dedupe job when backpressure spikes. logs incoming.
Priya (Support): can we get an embargoed list of affected tenants (ids only) so CS can prioritize outreach? need to start booking office hours.
Aisha (CS): yes — Ken, can you compile a short list and priority tier? cx2 / cx5 / cx9 are high-touch.
Ken (Account Exec): shared in DM. high-touch accounts: AcmeCorp, Bluewave, Northwell (all EU). They want timeline + mitigation.
Evan (Infra): we rolled a new retry policy at 02:12 UTC last night for the bulk pipeline. config snippet: ```
retry_policy: {
  max_attempts: 5
  backoff_ms: 200
  allow_concurrent_retries: true
}
```
Miguel (SRE): that `allow_concurrent_retries` is likely the culprit — duplicates when jobs overlap. plan: revert flag, run compact reindex for affected shards, and run dedupe pass. ETA 4-6h for bulk remediation, <2h for config rollback.
Aisha (CS): ok. Drafting customer note below — please sanity-check technical details + timeline. We should offer a one-time onboarding credit and 2 live office-hours sessions for affected customers.
Priya (Support): suggest phrasing: avoid technical blame, emphasize timeline + steps taken, offer opt-in for hands-on remediation. keep it <200 words.
Aisha (CS): draft (please copy/paste into outbound email template):
```
Hi <CustomerName>,

We wanted to let you know about a partial import issue that affected your recent onboarding batch processed on <date>. Some records were written twice and a small subset of indexed entries were truncated during processing. Our engineers have identified the cause and are taking steps to remediate:

1) We will run a targeted dedup and reindex for your tenant within the next 6 hours.
2) We have reverted a retry configuration to prevent recurrence.
3) We will schedule two live office hours (recorded) to walk through results and answer questions.

We apologize for the interruption. As a gesture of goodwill we are offering a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to 10% of this month’s committed spend and complimentary hands-on remediation if you’d like us to run the fix.

If you prefer not to wait for the automated remediation, reply and we will prioritize a manual restore.

Best,
Aisha on behalf of the Redwood Onboarding Team
```
Miguel (SRE): technical note looks fine. change timeline to "within 6 hours" -> "within 4-8 hours" to be safe. Also we should remove exact config references from customer email.
Aisha (CS): good call. updated.
Ken (Account Exec): recommend adding: "we will follow up with a post-incident summary and steps taken within 48 hours" — helps renewals.
Aisha (CS): added.
Priya (Support): we should include a short FAQ for customers: how to opt-in for manual fix, expected downtime (none), data integrity guarantees after fix. I'll draft.
IncidentBot: Incident created: INC-2026-0457 — partial import/dedupe issue. Severity: S2. Bridge: https://bridge.redwood/INC-2026-0457
Evan (Infra): quick rollback runbook: `kubectl set env deployment/bulk-import RETRY_CONCURRENT=false --namespace=prod` then monitor `import_success_rate` metric. I'll run rollback now.
Miguel (SRE): reindex started on affected shards (job id r-4471). Progress: 10% -> will post updates.
Aisha (CS): next steps for CS team: 1) Send embargoed email to high-touch list after technical confirmation (Miguel) 2) Open office hours calendar and invite affected customers 3) Prepare credit approval note and send to finance.
Ken (Account Exec): I'll notify AcmeCorp and Bluewave privately; they'll want legal cc. Ken -> legal on standby.
Priya (Support): drafting FAQ and a short slack-ready status snippet for customers who ping support.
Aisha (CS): thanks all. Miguel, ping here when the dedupe job finishes so we can hit send. prioritize translation for FR/DE/JA for these tenants. :pray:
